question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Bangladesh is a land of rivers. It has huge inland water resources and Hakaluki haor is a major wetland of it. It is located under two districts Maulvibazar and Sylhet. It was declared an Ecologically critical Area in April 1999. It is a valuable resting place for migratory waterfowls. Barheaded Goose was the most interesting waterfowl which is now hardly seen.
